messages:
zoe k: Heads-up: publish-typegen failed on release/canary. regen-check shows a missing changelog bullet that our new sample app added. commit is in branch but CI shows it removed.

ci-bot: GitHub Actions · publish-typegen · FAILED
Job: regen-check -> non-empty diff detected
Logs: `CHANGELOG.md: removed line 'Added: sample app - auth retry example'`

raph g: I can repro locally. `yarn typegen` adds the line, but `scripts/changelog-clean.js` later normalizes contributors and collapses what it thinks are duplicates. That drops the sample bullet.

mina l: That bullet was intended to force a minor bump. semver-detector sees no visible change after cleanup and skips bump, which aborts publish.

zoe k: Short-term unblock: push a tiny commit adding `<!-- keep-changelog-example -->` on that line so cleanup preserves it, re-run CI. We'll remove sentinel after a proper fix.

regen-bot: created issue #1910: "changelog-clean dedupe strips sample bullets -> semver false-negative" (assigned to raph g)

raph g: Plan: update changelog-clean to include parentheticals when computing dedupe keys for bullets containing `sample` or `Example`. Add unit tests and a small regendiff CI script that runs typegen+cleanup in the same image to avoid cross-job differences.

mina l: Also adding a semver-detector guard flag `--treat-cleanup-delta-as-change` so publishing is conservative until tooling is stable.

ci-bot: re-run triggered by zoe k: publish-typegen · queued

zoe k: Thanks. After raph's PR lands we'll remove the sentinel and re-run the pipeline to ensure a clean changelog. Leaving a note on the release board. :thumbsup:
